q4Depth.text: I want to learn a few more things from this path, without making it the focus of all my future training.
I want to spend real time developing this discipline and see how far I can take it.
I want to make continued growth in this discipline a major priority for my future.
I haven't decided how deeply I want to pursue this path. I'd rather see where it takes me.
